scope: Settings explicitly stated in the final manuscript; this inventory is not an executable run configuration

candidate_selection.rule: Highest reward among gate-passing candidates; omit proposals with no feasible candidate

editor_sft.initialization: Anchored warm-start adapter with relative-change cap
editor_sft.targets: Accepted self-generated targets plus identity/reconstruction replay
editor_sft.record_weights: Reward-weighted; mapping from reward to weight not specified

planner_sft.admission: Exclude all-fail and all-pass candidate groups; apply proposal reward and quality thresholds

training_signal_roles.primary: Editor-exposed Qwen image/text features, VAE latents and programmatic image checks
training_signal_roles.verifier_bank_analysis: Editor-side VLM yes/no token log-probabilities; external detector described for the addition variant
training_signal_roles.benchmark_evaluation: External benchmark judges; not target-selection signals

details_needed_from_final_run: Background-purity and object-completeness formulas, thresholds and gate integration
Warm-start adapter identity, anchor coefficient and relative-change cap value
Source manifest, edit-family schedule and round boundaries
Final adapter identities and benchmark generation/scoring receipts
Step1X training, internal feature and inference backend
